en.short: Draw the entity-relationship diagram of your CREATE TABLE statements.

en.description: Paste CREATE TABLE statements and get the entity-relationship diagram with tables, columns, primary and foreign keys and relations, drawn with Mermaid. Export it to SVG or PNG, or open it in the Mermaid editor.
